_description: Cooperative sociali (CNEL T151) level C1, January 2026 regular run, permanent, full time: the minimo of the third tranche of the 26 January 2024 renewal (from October 2025).
_notes: Minimo C1 1,545.21 from October 2025 (Art. 76, third tranche 'con la mensilità di ottobre 2025'); no later tranche signed through October 2026.
Corroborated by the Ministry D.D. 30/2024 cost table for January 2026, annual minimi C1 18.542,52 / 12 = 1,545.21 (physical page 191 of the same PDF).
Base salary only: allowances and seniority depend on facts outside the national table.

source.document: CCNL Cooperative sociali 2023-2025, testo completo (edizione Legacoopsociali 2025)
